newsitem.title: JAPAN: Green Cross to import Bristol-Myers HIV drug Zerit.
newsitem.headline: Green Cross to import Bristol-Myers HIV drug Zerit.

text.p: Japanese drug maker Green Cross Corp said on Friday it had obtained the Japanese drug authority's approval to import Bristol-Myers Squibb Co's HIV drug Zerit.
A spokesman for Green Cross said the company expects to start marketing the drug in Japan by the end of July.
The spokesman said the company expects first-year sales of the drug to be less than 100 million yen.
Zerit was introduced in the U.S. market in 1994.
Green Cross has been at the centre of a scandal surrounding blood products tainted with HIV, the virus that causes AIDS.
